name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-snes-battle-x2-x3-style
title: Shin Megami Tensei (SNES) - Battle (X2 + X3 Style)
description:
Shin Megami Tensei (SNES)'s battle theme, now in X2/X3 style! Mostly useful for chase levels or a boss.

Update 2017/07/30: To avoid slowdown, I decreased the tempo and put notes closer together, and that has helped a great deal. I also removed a sample that wasn't really needed, fixed octave issue in the bass part, reworked guitar solo, and misc other things which made the insert size about 20 percent smaller!
